name: MEXC现货交易所
description: 全球第三大Spot CEX，2025年增长最快的主流CEX之一，全年Spot Volume YoY增长+90.9%，达到$1.5T。已做到全球第三大Spot CEX（9.1%市占率）。总部位于新加坡，服务全球170+个国家和地区，拥有超过4000万用户。
descriptionEn: The world's third-largest Spot CEX, one of the fastest-growing mainstream CEXs in 2025, with Spot Volume YoY growth of +90.9% to $1.5T. Ranking third globally in Spot CEX (9.1% market share). Headquartered in Singapore, serving 170+ countries and regions with over 40 million users.

name: Maxinsights
description: 高速成长的种子轮具身智能初创公司，致力于构建下一代机器人智能基础设施。End-to-End Data Solutions For Embodied AI，做数据为主，针对机器人/具身智能行业，数据是从真实生活中获取手部数据、人体数据，给大模型使用。在北京、苏州和Santa Clara都有Office，目前全职员工超过100人。
descriptionEn: A fast-growing seed-stage embodied AI startup committed to building the next generation of robotics intelligent infrastructure. End-to-End Data Solutions For Embodied AI, focusing on data solutions for robotics/embodied AI industry. Data is collected from real-life scenarios including hand data and human body data for LLM training. Offices in Beijing, Suzhou, and Santa Clara, with over 100 full-time employees.

name: Nirva
description: Nirva 是全球最具美感、也最具洞察力的 AI 可穿戴首饰——第一款真正为全天佩戴而设计的 AI 设备。成立约3个月即获 Best of CES 2026 及「最佳 CES 创业公司」奖项。主打 AI 可穿戴首饰类产品，如智能耳环、项链等，聚焦生活化场景，如日记记录、自我认知辅助、情感陪伴。Pre-seed 轮由美国 South Park Commons（SPC）领投，金额为 40 万美元，并承诺后续跟投 60 万美元，总计约 100 万美元。
descriptionEn: Nirva is the world's most beautiful and insightful AI wearable jewelry — the first AI device truly designed for all-day wear. Founded ~3 months ago, Nirva won Best of CES 2026 and 'Best CES Startup' award. The company focuses on AI wearable jewelry products such as smart earrings and necklaces, targeting life-oriented scenarios like journaling, self-awareness assistance, and emotional companionship. Pre-seed round led by US-based South Park Commons (SPC) with $400k investment and $600k committed follow-on, totaling ~$1M.

descriptionEn: AI shopping agent for North American market - scours the web, finds best deals, and executes purchases automatically

name: Sudo AI
description: Sudo AI 成立于2024年，是全球增长最快的具身智能独角兽之一，估值超20亿美元。投资方包括阿里巴巴、腾讯、宁德时代(GL Ventures)、IDG资本等。公司于2026年4月发布#sudo R1，是软硬件全栈自研的机器人系统，核心为基于纯仿真训练的操作基础模型（以物体抓取为核心）。完全无需真实世界数据、人类演示或逐物体微调，即可实现对从未见过的物体的高可靠抓取，60分钟连续测试接近100%成功率。
descriptionEn: Sudo AI, founded in 2024, is one of the fastest-growing embodied AI unicorns globally, with a valuation exceeding $2 billion. Investors include Alibaba, Tencent, CATL (Ningde Times), GL Ventures, IDG Capital, and others. The company launched #sudo R1 in April 2026, a fully self-developed robotics system featuring an operation foundation model trained purely in simulation (centered on object grasping). Without real-world data, human demonstrations, or per-object fine-tuning, it achieves high-reliability grasping of unseen objects with near 100% success rate in 60-minute continuous testing.

name: 全球内容社区平台
description: 成熟的全球化内容社区平台，已建立覆盖多元垂类的活跃创作者生态，并持续拓展国际市场。团队致力于通过社区、内容与产品能力，帮助全球创作者建立影响力并实现长期成长。
descriptionEn: An established global content community platform with an active creator ecosystem spanning diverse verticals and a growing international presence. The team helps creators build influence and achieve long-term growth through community, content, and product capabilities.

name: 全球 AI 创意设计 Agent 平台
nameEn: Global AI Creative Design Agent Platform
description: 全球领先的 AI 原生创意科技公司，核心产品以设计 Agent 重构从品牌视觉、营销素材到完整创意工作流的生产方式。公司产品生态已服务超过 3,000 万用户，累计融资近 3 亿美元，估值超过 20 亿美元，拥有成熟的多模态 AI 技术、全球化产品能力和快速扩张的国际市场团队。
descriptionEn: A leading AI-native creative technology company redefining how branding, visual design, marketing assets, and end-to-end creative workflows are produced through design agents. Its product ecosystem serves more than 30 million users. With nearly US$300 million in funding and a valuation exceeding US$2 billion, the company combines mature multimodal AI capabilities with strong global product execution and a rapidly expanding international team.
location: 上海 / 旧金山 / 纽约 / 东京 / 首尔
locationEn: Shanghai / San Francisco / New York / Tokyo / Seoul

name: VidaWheel
description: 以女性主义为核心理念的灵性疗愈科技品牌，以神女能量珠宝、智能软硬件和 AI 疗愈产品为载体，结合荣格心理学与古希腊女神原型叙事，为职场女性提供有尊严、有文化深度的心理支持。品牌正在建设全球女性互助社群 Queendom.S，连接女性主义者、身心疗愈者与女性社区，并将部分收入捐赠给全球女性公益组织。
descriptionEn: A feminist spiritual-wellness technology brand combining goddess-inspired jewelry, intelligent hardware, software, and AI-guided healing experiences. Grounded in Jungian psychology and Greek goddess archetypes, it provides culturally thoughtful, dignified emotional support for women. Its global mutual-support community, Queendom.S, connects feminists, wellness practitioners, and women's communities, while a portion of brand revenue supports women's nonprofit organizations worldwide.

name: ActionX
description: ActionX 成立于 2026 年，是一家全球化 AI Native 公司，已获得硅谷风险投资机构等数百万美元天使轮投资。创始团队兼具顶尖多模态算法研究与连续创业经验，曾参与 MSRA 多模态大模型研究，并主导过百万用户级 AI 产品从 0 到 1 的研发与商业化。公司当前以 CodeX 切入广告投放与卖家增长场景，通过 Agent 打通 Insight、Creative 与 Data 闭环，构建面向全球市场的 AI 原生商业增长基础设施。公司在北京和美国均设有主体。
descriptionEn: Founded in 2026, ActionX is a global AI-native company backed by several million US dollars in angel funding from Silicon Valley venture investors and other institutions. Its founding team combines frontier multimodal AI research with repeatedly validated 0-to-1 entrepreneurship, including experience in multimodal foundation-model research and building AI products that reached more than one million users. Its current product, CodeX, serves advertising and seller-growth workflows, using agents to connect Insight, Creative, and Data into an end-to-end commercial growth loop. The company operates entities in both Beijing and the United States.

name: Novvy
description: 硅谷 AI 创业公司，创始团队来自 Google Ads、Meta Ads 与 Meta Superintelligence Labs，致力于构建 AI 时代的新一代广告商业化基础设施。团队规模不足 10 人，已融资约 600 万美元；供给侧已连接头部出海短剧产品，覆盖超过 1,000 万 DAU，预算侧已连接头部休闲游戏及电商平台，可触达广告预算超过 1 亿美元，并获得多位广告科技行业资深创业者与投资人的支持。
descriptionEn: A Silicon Valley AI startup founded by veterans of Google Ads, Meta Ads, and Meta Superintelligence Labs, building next-generation monetization infrastructure for AI-native content and entertainment. The team has fewer than 10 people and has raised approximately US$6 million. On the supply side, it works with leading global short-drama products reaching more than 10 million DAU; on the demand side, it connects with top casual-game and e-commerce advertisers with access to over US$100 million in budget, backed by experienced advertising technology founders and investors.
stage: 早期融资约 600 万美元

name: 全球 AI 达人营销平台
description: 全球领先的 AI 原生达人营销双边平台，汇聚超过 5 万名认证科技创作者，并服务快速成长的 AI、消费电子、电商与游戏品牌。团队分布北美与亚洲，核心成员来自全球领先科技企业和连续创业团队，在欧美市场与中国品牌出海市场均拥有专业 GTM 能力，致力于以 AI 建设更高效、智能、透明的达人营销基础设施。
descriptionEn: A leading AI-native two-sided creator marketing platform connecting more than 50,000 verified technology creators with fast-growing AI, consumer electronics, e-commerce, and gaming brands. Its North America and Asia-based team combines global technology and repeat-founder experience, building more efficient, intelligent, and transparent infrastructure for creator marketing.
location: 北京总部 / 北美 / 中国多地
locationEn: Beijing HQ / North America / Multiple China Locations

name: Vord AI
description: 早期隐私优先 AI 对话产品，通过统一界面连接 Claude、GPT、Gemini 与开放权重模型。与依赖服务条款承诺的常见方案不同，其基础设施只基于元数据完成路由，不接触用户输入内容，将隐私保护建立在产品架构本身。团队致力于为工作沟通、法律与医疗问题及敏感创意场景提供兼具主流产品体验与强隐私保障的 AI 工具。
descriptionEn: An early-stage, privacy-first AI chat product that provides access to Claude, GPT, Gemini, and open-weight models through one interface. Its infrastructure routes on metadata without seeing prompt contents, grounding the privacy guarantee in architecture rather than policy promises. The team is building a mainstream-quality experience for sensitive work conversations, legal and medical questions, and private ideas.
location: 全球远程（优先亚太，也考虑美国）

name: 全球主动式 AI 生活平台
description: 一家面向欧美与东南亚等全球市场的 ToC AI 创业公司，正在打造以生活方式为核心的主动式 AI 助手。产品通过长期理解用户的日常习惯、兴趣偏好与生活场景，主动提供本地生活建议，并逐步协助完成预约、订购和行程安排等任务，让 AI Agent 不只回答问题，也能真正参与用户的日常生活。
descriptionEn: A consumer AI startup serving global markets across North America, Europe, and Southeast Asia. The team is building a proactive lifestyle assistant that learns users' routines, interests, and preferences over time, recommends relevant local experiences, and helps complete tasks such as reservations, ordering, and planning. The goal is to make an AI agent that participates meaningfully in everyday life rather than merely answering questions.

name: 全球 Physical AI 数据与仿真平台
nameEn: Global Physical AI Data & Simulation Platform
description: 全球领先的 Physical AI 数据与仿真基础设施公司，围绕 3D 仿真数据、仿真遥操作与自动驾驶合成数据三大方向，提供从数据采集、策略训练、仿真评测到 Sim2Real 部署的全流程解决方案。公司已完成多轮大额融资，年营收突破亿元，并与全球头部芯片、大模型、机器人、汽车及工业企业建立合作，规模化交付与商业化能力已得到市场验证。
descriptionEn: A leading Physical AI data and simulation infrastructure company spanning three core areas: 3D simulation data, simulation-based teleoperation, and synthetic data for autonomous driving. It provides end-to-end solutions from data collection and policy training to simulation evaluation and Sim2Real deployment. The company has completed multiple major funding rounds, surpassed RMB 100 million in annual revenue, and works with leading global chip, foundation-model, robotics, automotive, and industrial companies, demonstrating validated commercial and large-scale delivery capabilities.

name: 全球在线旅行与酒店预订平台
description: 全球领先的一站式在线旅行服务平台，以技术连接旅行者与全球酒店、交通、目的地及其他旅行服务。平台拥有成熟的国际化产品体系、多语言与多币种服务能力，并持续通过搜索、内容、数据和本地化运营提升全球用户的旅行预订体验。
descriptionEn: A leading global one-stop online travel platform connecting travelers with hotels, transportation, destinations, and other travel services through technology. The platform operates a mature international product ecosystem with multilingual and multi-currency capabilities, continuously improving global travel discovery and booking through search, content, data, and localization.
